device.description: 12-bit 175/360 kSPS single-channel serial SAR ADC with autopower-down
device.note: slas276d.pdf (SLAS276D, TLC2551/TLC2552/TLC2555) p.1 pinouts, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 output data format (12 result bits + 4 don't-care, straight binary), p.4-5 control and timing, p.6 timing diagrams (Figures 2-5), p.7 SCLK and conversion speed, p.9 recommended operating conditions and timing, p.12-13 critical timing (Figures 6-9)

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (data format, control), p.5 (MUX reset, conversion), p.6 (Figures 2-5), p.7 (SCLK and conversion speed), p.9 (recommended operating conditions, timing), p.12-13 (critical timing)
notModeled: analog inputs and VREF; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (28 SCLKs after the 16th SCLK falling edge); the result shown in a frame is the previous cycle's conversion, which the constant 0 V code makes identical

SPI mode: SDO changes on SCLK rising edges and is read on falling edges, the MSB appearing at CS falling (p.4, Figure 7); the datasheet recommends CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1 for an SPI host, modeled as mode 2 (sample on the falling edge, first bit at CS fall)
D3-D0 are don't-care bits (p.4); modeled as zeros
SDO goes to Hi-Z 30 ns after the 17th SCLK rising edge (td(SCLK17H-SDOZ), p.9); modeled as idle Hi-Z after the 16-bit frame; tFloat uses the same 30 ns (no CS-rise-to-Z time is given)
a CS rise before the conversion completes aborts it and invalidates the next output (cycle time sample + convert + 1 SCLK, p.5, p.7); the required SCLK while CS is high (p.7)
autopower-down after each conversion and wake-up on CS falling (p.7): no bus-visible effect
SCLK frequency limits and throughput (Table 1, p.8)
FS frame-sync input (TMS320 DSP mode, control via CS and FS or FS only, p.4-5, p.7): only CS control (FS tied high) is modeled; FS is an unused input
variants: TLC2552: dual-channel autosweep (AIN0/AIN1), SCLK on pin 7, no FS; TLC2555: pseudo-differential AIN(+)/AIN(-), SCLK on pin 7, no FS; same frame
